description: Compare each timing group's average institutional ownership with the overall per-snapshot average. For the groups above it, report the mean of their averages and their mean excess.

b.request: Among sentimentandfundamentals rows with non-null instownpct, grouped by eventannotm (NULL as its own group), compare each group's AVG(instownpct) to the overall per-row AVG(instownpct), and return in one row the AVG of the group averages strictly above the overall average and the AVG of their excess (group average minus overall average), unrounded
b.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT eventannotm, instownpct FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS overall_avg FROM base), grp AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS grp_avg FROM base GROUP BY eventannotm) SELECT AVG(g.grp_avg) AS avg_group_avg_above, AVG(g.grp_avg - o.overall_avg) AS avg_excess FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE g.grp_avg > o.overall_avg;

c.request: Looking at announcement timing (`eventannotm`, with a missing timing as its own group), which timings have an average institutional ownership strictly above average? Ignoring missing ownership values, give in one row the mean of those timings' average ownership and how far above average they are on average, without rounding. Compare each timing group's average institutional ownership with the overall per-snapshot average. For the groups above it, report the mean of their averages and their mean excess.
c.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT COALESCE(eventannotm, 'Missing') AS timing, instownpct FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL), grp AS (SELECT timing, AVG(instownpct) AS grp_avg FROM base GROUP BY timing), overall AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS overall_avg FROM base) SELECT AVG(g.grp_avg) AS mean_group_avg, AVG(g.grp_avg - o.overall_avg) AS mean_excess FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE g.grp_avg > o.overall_avg;

a.request: Group the sentiment and fundamentals snapshots by announcement timing (`eventannotm`), treating a missing timing as its own group, and compute each group's average institutional ownership (`instownpct`), ignoring missing values. Take as the baseline the average institutional ownership across all individual snapshots, ignoring missing values, so larger groups weigh more. For the groups whose average is strictly above that baseline, give in one row the mean of their averages and the mean amount by which they exceed the baseline, without rounding.
a.sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS grp_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), base AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS baseline FROM sentimentandfundamentals), above AS (SELECT g.grp_avg, g.grp_avg - b.baseline AS excess FROM grp g CROSS JOIN base b WHERE g.grp_avg > b.baseline) SELECT AVG(grp_avg) AS mean_of_group_averages, AVG(excess) AS mean_excess_over_baseline FROM above;

d.request: Among the timing groups in `eventannotm` (including the missing-timing group), which have an average institutional ownership strictly above the overall per-snapshot average? Ignoring missing ownership values, what are the mean of those groups' averages and their mean excess over the overall average, reported in one row without rounding?
d.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS overall_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL), grp AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS grp_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY eventannotm), above AS (SELECT g.grp_avg, g.grp_avg - o.overall_avg AS excess FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE g.grp_avg > o.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(grp_avg) AS mean_group_avg, AVG(excess) AS mean_excess FROM above;
